case.name: range_join_union_after_update_text_pk_memory
case.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(x) FROM (SELECT x FROM (SELECT t.v AS x,t.seq AS seq,t.grp AS grp FROM t JOIN u ON u.id=t.seq WHERE t.id BETWEEN printf('%016x', 10398) AND printf('%016x', 75933)) UNION ALL SELECT v FROM u);
case.prepare: UPDATE t SET v=v+1 WHERE seq%8=0;
